metadata.title: OpenTUI native help successor with ready-gated PTY

work.objective: Independently fix and prove the Bun/OpenTUI /help flow: wait for a ready focused composer, open the real help dialog without TextNodeRenderable errors, render the help footer, close with Esc, then exit with Ctrl+C.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every read, search, edit and command.
Only modify packages/cli/src/ui/opentui/**; do not modify Ink, renderer dispatch, dependencies, lockfiles, Marshal state, commit, push, publish, use network access or start subagents.
Do not import or copy files from the blocked R1 Marshal worktree; independently implement from the current branch and frozen requirements.
Keep this a native help correctness fix; do not perform the broader visual parity redesign.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed relative-path equivalent or report blocked.
context: R1 corrected nested text/span composition and added help coverage but its frozen PTY sent /help before terminal initialization; the mandatory run timed out and R1 exhausted its retry/rework budget. No R1 patch was integrated.
The successor PTY first waits for the rendered ready status, then sends /help. This distinguishes focus/readiness timing from help rendering correctness.

Inspect all help descendants for child types supported by the real @opentui/react reconciler. Prove the footer text appears, Esc closes the dialog, and Ctrl+C reaches EOF without TextNodeRenderable or critical errors.
Preserve existing slash gateway, command processing, mouse behavior, prompt behavior and current POC layout; visual 1:1 is a later task.
